days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 135 ? logged 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 last Monday. You showed up and that matters, but the weight isn't moving at those RPEs. Touch the chest, pause a full second, drive through the heels, stay braced. You need 9-10 reps across all three sets at RPE 7 to earn 140. Take the full 90 seconds. Push the rep count this week.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? logged 10/9/8 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Set 1 hit the top of the range but sets 2 and 3 dropped off and effort stayed high throughout. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45, 2-second negative. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. Stop letting the later sets slip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 35 ? logged 8/8/8 at RPE 9/9/9 last week. RPE 9 across every single set is too hard. You're grinding through this weight, not owning it. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. You need all three sets at RPE 7-8 before we talk about moving up. Focus on control and breathing this week.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? logged 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Bottom of the rep range, effort too high. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbows, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative down. Stop swinging the weight up. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 20. Add two reps per set this week.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: UP to 95 ? wait, you were already at 95. Staying at 95 ? logged 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 last week. That's a clean three-for-three at the top of the range with controlled effort. You earned the bump to 100 lbs. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked, lower to the chest, full lockout every rep. New weight, same execution. Log all three sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? baseline established last week: 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. You picked 45 and hit the reps, but effort was high across all three sets. Single dumbbell, both hands, elbows pointing straight up, lower behind the head, full extension at the top. Need 10-12 reps at RPE 7 to earn the bump. Control the eccentric.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 195 ? logged 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 last Wednesday. Set 3 crept to RPE 9, which is too close to the edge. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, full breath and brace before every rep. Take the full 2 minutes between sets ? don't shortchange the rest. Need 8+ reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or lower to earn 205. Manage your fatigue.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 110 ? logged 10/9/8 at RPE 7/8/8 last week. Set 1 was solid but you lost reps and gained RPE as the sets went on. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. The drop-off between sets is the issue to fix.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? logged 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Set 1 hit the top but sets 2 and 3 dropped to 8 reps. One hand on the bench, pull to your hip, full squeeze at the top for one second, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is fading on sets 2 and 3. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Staying at 70 ? logged 12/12/12 at RPE 7/8/8 last week. Set 1 was clean at RPE 7 but sets 2 and 3 climbed. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, full external rotation. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Push the rep count on sets 2 and 3 this week.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: UP to 35 ? earned it with 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/7 last week. All three sets clean at the top of the range with controlled effort. That's exactly what progression looks like. Neutral grip, elbows pinned, no swinging, full curl, controlled negative. New weight ? log how it feels across all three sets.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out EZ bar curl after establishing a baseline last week (35 lbs, 10/12/12 at RPE 6/7/7 ? weight was light, we'll cycle back). Bringing in dumbbell curl for variety this week. Alternating or simultaneous, elbows pinned to your sides, supinate at the top, controlled negative. Pick a weight where 8-10 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? logged 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 last Friday. Same result as the week before. You're stuck at 8 reps and stuck at RPE 8. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole. Take the full 2 minutes ? no shortcuts. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. The rep count is the thing to attack this week.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 155 ? logged 10/9/10 at RPE 7/8/8 last week. Set 1 was great, sets 2 and 3 lost a rep each and effort climbed. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, do not let the lower back round. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165. Sets 2 and 3 are where you're losing it ? focus there.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? logged 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Every session at this weight has been the exact same result. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin vertical, drive through the front heel. You have more in the tank ? stop racking it at 10. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 35. Push past 10 on every single set this week.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 85 ? logged 12/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. Set 1 hit 12 reps but sets 2 and 3 dropped to 10 and effort was high across the board. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension, hard squeeze at the top for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 across all three to earn 90. Don't let sets 2 and 3 fall apart.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? logged 13/14/15 at RPE 8/8/8 last week. All three sets completed this time ? good. Rep count is building (13, 14, 15) but effort is still too high. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled return ? no jerking. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 60. You're close ? get the RPE down.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out hanging leg raise after the baseline session last week (8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8). Bringing in cable crunch for variety. Kneel facing the pulley, rope behind your head, crunch with your abs ? not your hips. Don't just pull the weight down with your arms. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
